notes.title: The Grey Galactic Demo has been updated!
notes.content:
The Grey Galactic demo has been updated to build number v0.1.12, which includes the following updates:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the construction of Space Stations to crash the game.
[*]Fixed a graphical issue of planet overlays when a level or scenario was won or lost.
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the player from completing Mastering Attacking in the Tutorial Campaign.
[*]Fixed a bug that incorrectly loaded a null map after completing Mastering Attacking in the Tutorial Campaign.
[*]Updated the enemy AI to not skip over planets with enemies present.
[*]Added options to control ship trails and camera movement when the mouse is on the edge of the screen.
[*]Implemented various bug fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]

These updates can be downloaded directly from Steam. For any questions, concerns, or feedback, please reach out in the official Grey Galactic Discord channel!

notes.title: The Grey Galactic free demo is now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm super excited to announce that after 3 years of solo development, the free demo of my real time strategy game Grey Galactic is finally available to play on Steam!

If you'd like a direct link to the Steam store, you can click here!
steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2236170/

I love RTS games, but they're surprisingly difficult to make by yourself. If you like strategy games, I'd love for the folks here to give the demo a try, and let me know what your thoughts are! I'll be releasing in early access in December, so any and all feedback can absolutely be implemented into the game as needed. Thank you for taking a look, and I hope you enjoy!
